About this role


We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next.

That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go.

Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Lead - UK
jobs.description:
About us

Salience Labs is building an industry-defining approach to optical circuit switching for AI infrastructure, engineered for real latency reduction and cost savings at hyperscale. We’re moving from proven technology to real world deployment at scale, and joining at this stage means genuine ownership over that next chapter, working alongside a small, highly technical team on one of the most consequential problems in AI infrastructure today.

The Role

This is a hands-on, delivery-focused recruiter role. As Talent Acquisition Lead in the UK, you will run recruiting end to end in an early-stage environment. The work is broad and the pace is high. You will go directly into the market to headhunt the best possible candidates for each role opened.

You will report to the Head of Talent and work closely with hiring managers to fill roles based in the UK and Europe.

jobs.title: Business Development Intern (Mandarin Speaker)
jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Global Sellers Team mission at Back Market is to enable a stable supply of high quality refurbished products to our 17 markets. The team is fast-growing, we onboard and nurture great sellers to unlock the right products that our customers want.

jobs.description:
Du findest Salonkee spannend, hast aber keine passende Stelle gefunden? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Initiativbewerbung.



DEINE MISSION
Salonkee ist die All-in-one-Software für Salons, Barbershops und Beauty-Betriebe – von der Terminbuchung über Kundenverwaltung und Kasse bis zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen. Über 10.000 Betriebe in sieben Ländern vertrauen uns bereits. In Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz wachsen wir gerade stark und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg mit uns gehen – ob im Vertrieb, im Onboarding, im Customer Success oder darüber hinaus.



DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweis

  • Lust, dazuzulernen und Feedback umzusetzen

  • Sicheren Umgang mit digitalen Tools

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch

jobs.title: Data analist Lenen, Sparen & Retailbeleggen
jobs.description:
De afdeling Lenen, Sparen en Retailbeleggen (LSR) houdt toezicht op financiële producten en diensten voor consumenten, zoals hypotheken, kredieten, sparen, betalen en beleggen. We zorgen dat informatie duidelijk is en dat online dienstverlening goed toegankelijk is. Samen zorgen we dat het klantbelang centraal staat, vooral voor kwetsbare groepen.

 

Ons toezicht richt zich op het herkennen en aanpakken van risico’s voor consumenten. We willen dit zo snel en effectief mogelijk doen. Om meer impact te maken, gebruiken we data op een slimme manier. Daarbij zoeken we continu naar signalen, toetsen we aannames en brengen we risico’s en mogelijke blinde vlekken in beeld. Zo kunnen we sneller inspelen op veranderingen in de financiële sector.

 

De vraagstukken waar je aan werkt zijn vaak nieuw, complex en actueel. Denk aan risico’s rond Buy Now Pay Later, online beleggingsplatformen, AI-toepassingen of ontwikkelingen in de cryptomarkt. Jouw analyses dragen direct bij aan keuzes die de AFM maakt in haar toezicht.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Product Engineering
jobs.description:
Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone

Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.

At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires.

I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves.

Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games.
